headline: Xbox tests digitizing disc games for digital play
summary: Xbox is testing a way to digitize physical games for digital play, following Sony's plan to kill off PlayStation game discs.
details: Xbox is reportedly testing a program to digitize physical games, allowing players to play digital copies of their physical games without needing the disc. This approach would bond a digital version of a game to its physical disc.
The program, which started testing recently, would cover Xbox One and Xbox Series X titles, but not games for the original Xbox or Xbox 360. Not every Xbox One game may be supported.
This would enable players to stream games via Xbox Cloud Gaming if compatible and with a Game Pass membership. The program also supports Xbox Play Anywhere for PC and handhelds.

The disc-to-digital program could mitigate the issue of disc rot and ensure that Xbox owners can access their physical game purchases on future hardware. It may be a while before Xbox officially announces the program.
caption:

This would enable players to stream games via Xbox Cloud Gaming if compatible and with a Game Pass membership. The program also supports Xbox Play Anywhere for PC and handhelds.

The disc-to-digital program could mitigate the issue of disc rot and ensure that Xbox owners can access their physical game purchases on future hardware. It may be a while before Xbox officially announces the program.
